panel.changeClosed: Change game type was open until <when>{{time}}</when>. After 5 minutes, end or discard this frame first.
panel.ended: This game is no longer running.

move.title: Move {{name}} to another table
move.subtitle: <name>{{who}}</name>, frame {{n}}, {{sofar}}
move.none: There is no other table of this kind to move to.
move.note: The timer and session move with the players. A frame keeps the price of the table it started on. A Century keeps counting minutes on the new table.

replace.title: Replace a player on {{name}}
replace.text: Earlier frames stay with the old player.

stop.title: Stop {{name}} without the normal charge
stop.subtitle: <name>{{who}}</name>, {{what}}, {{price}}. Owners see every stopped frame with its reason.

discard.title: Discard frame
discard.text: Nobody pays. Use when the frame did not really happen.

dispute.title: Unpaid, dispute
dispute.text: Players are arguing. The frame waits, and an owner decides who pays.

cancel.title: Cancel, started by mistake
cancel.text: Wrong table or wrong players. In the first 2 minutes it works like Undo: no reason, nothing charged.

stop.undoLike: Started less than 2 minutes ago, so this works like Undo: no reason is needed and nothing is charged.

damage.title: Add a damage charge
damage.text: For a broken cue, a damaged ball or torn cloth. It goes on the player’s bill with a note.
damage.footer: Shows on <name>{{name}}</name>’s statement as a damage charge. Owners see it in Activity.
damage.footerPlain: Shows on the player’s statement as a damage charge. Owners see it in Activity.

pause.title: All games are paused
pause.text: Paused at <when>{{time}}</when> by the counter. Timers are stopped, so nobody is charged for the power cut.
pause.note: If the computer itself switched off, every game is restored with the right time when it starts again.
pause.freeHint: New games can still start. Pause them too if the power is out.
